generator.sourceNote: Generated inside a built CapStash Core checkout by calling CBlockHeader::GetPoWHash(); Whirlpool-512 output is null because CAPSTASH_CORE_VECTOR_WITH_WHIRLPOOL was not enabled.

byteOrderNotes.headerHexBeforeNonce: 80-byte serialized header before nonce patching, internal byte order exactly as hashed.
byteOrderNotes.patchedHeaderHex: 80-byte serialized header after little-endian nonce patch at bytes 76..79.
byteOrderNotes.foldedInternalHex: 32 folded PoW bytes in internal uint256 byte order.
byteOrderNotes.foldedHashHex: Core uint256 display hex, the reverse of foldedInternalHex bytes.
byteOrderNotes.whirlpool512Hex: Plain Whirlpool-512 digest bytes before XOR folding when available.
